independence: Independent round-2 auditor for ur: did not translate or remediate these catalogues, read the translator's output only as bytes, used no translation/MT service or back-translation, and made no catalogue, ledger or git edit. This receipt is the only repository write.
method: Read the ur style guide and the programme glossary first, then the English source with each key's context sidecar, then the translated bytes; judged by native-fluent reading of ur against en and the call sites (grep of src/renderer/src/features/agents and features/agent-hub), with no MT service. Mechanical checks were derived, not trusted: a scratch Node script parsed all 321 messages with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and compared argument names/types, plural arms, NFC, bidi controls, punctuation and code-span counts against en, plus a Latin-token check for identifiers/commands/products. Composition was checked in code: publication-failure.ts (publicationTreatment, pullRefusalMessage), upload-agent-dialog.tsx (terms lead+link+tail, target label), and label-in-name for pull_target, brief.trigger_aria, delegate.aria, collaboration/project_brief/members aria.

findings.current: حاصل کریں · حاصل کیا جا رہا ہے… · ٹیم {name} حاصل کریں; “{name}” حاصل نہیں ہو سکی۔; ٹیم حاصل نہیں ہو سکی۔; … پھر دوبارہ حاصل کریں۔
findings.problem: The programme glossary's wave-2 kept-English set keeps `pull` for git/hub operations ('Inflect around them; never translate inside them'), and shipped ur already does exactly that on this surface: ui.hub.subscriptions.pull = 'اب pull کریں' and ui.hub.subscriptions.subscribe_description = 'دستی pull دستیاب رہتا ہے'. The six new keys name the same hub pull operation as حاصل, so the new hub.roster button contradicts the locale's shipped hub vocabulary and the glossary; no divergence is recorded in i18n/style-guides/ur.md. Same ruling the es round-2 audit made (ES-R2-H1). Direct neighbours on this surface that carry the same verb and should move with it (round-1 bytes): ui.hub.teams.public.intro 'کوئی ٹیم حاصل کرنے پر', ui.hub.teams.public.sign_in_hint 'کوئی ٹیم حاصل کرنے کے لیے'.
findings.suggested: Pull · Pull ہو رہا ہے… · ٹیم {name} کو Pull کریں · “{name}” کو Pull نہیں کیا جا سکا۔ · ٹیم کو Pull نہیں کیا جا سکا۔ · … پھر دوبارہ Pull کریں۔ (running text lower-case 'pull', as the shipped subscription strings do; the visible label must stay inside pull_target/its aria name)

findings.current: {visible} از {total, plural, one {# ٹیم} other {# ٹیمیں}} اس صفحے پر “{query}” سے مطابقت رکھتی ہیں
findings.problem: The trailing verb is outside the ICU plural and is fixed feminine-plural, so the `one` arm produces broken agreement: total=1 renders '0/1 از 1 ٹیم … مطابقت رکھتی ہیں' (needs رکھتی ہے). fr/ru/zh-CN avoided this by recasting the sentence as a label ('Matches for “{query}” on this page: {visible} of {total}'); the English source's own plural verb has the same latent edge, but the target can fix it without changing the placeholders.
findings.suggested: اس صفحے پر “{query}” سے مطابقت: {visible} از {total, plural, one {# ٹیم} other {# ٹیمیں}}

findings.problem: English 'Publish to' is the <Label> of the destination Select (upload-agent-dialog.tsx:938-952; its options are ui.hub.pages.scope.public 'Public hub' and organization names). 'یہاں' means HERE, so the label reads 'Publish here' and names the current place instead of the destination the reader must choose; it contradicts the options below it and every other locale (fr 'Publier vers', es 'Publicar en', ru 'Куда опубликовать', hi 'कहाँ प्रकाशित करें', zh-CN '发布到', vi 'Xuất bản đến'). Sidecar: 'Introduces the public hub and organization targets below it.'
